## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the user-visible problem and what changes. Link an issue if one exists.

## Verification

List the checks actually run and results; explain skipped checks. Use sanitized screenshots for visual changes when useful. Distinguish synthetic fixtures from live-provider evidence.

## Review

- [ ] This change contains no API keys, CLI credentials, cookies, account files or private account data.
- [ ] Provider support claims distinguish implemented, partial, planned and discovery-only behavior; missing data remains distinct from zero.
- [ ] Relevant documentation and tests are updated, or the verification section explains why they are unchanged.
